presets.name: Muon Strike
presets.description: Tight front, sustain held back, a little sub for weight: the default kick fixer.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Air Shower Kick
presets.description: Long boom: low sustain up, the click softened, tuned ring an octave below the root.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Pion Click
presets.description: All beater: the high band's attack pushed and clipped for a hard click that cuts on phones.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Cherenkov Thump
presets.description: Low-band punch with tube warmth on the attack only: round, dense, forward.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Sub Lepton
presets.description: An octave-down generator under the kick, clean purity, mono below 120 Hz.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tuned Impact
presets.description: The kick rings at the song's root: tuned resonators on octaves, struck by the transient.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Phantom Kick
presets.description: Harmonics 2 to 4 of the low end so the kick is heard on small speakers; the fundamental trimmed.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Gated Boom
presets.description: Big attack, sustain cut hard: a short, gated thud that leaves room for the bass.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Skin Kick
presets.description: A membrane body under the kick: the Skin material struck a fifth above the root.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Distant Muon
presets.description: Softened attack, a lifted tail and a short Afterglow: the kick from the back of the room.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Crack Front
presets.description: The top band's snap pushed and slightly clipped; the body left alone.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Fat Body
presets.description: Mid-band sustain up with tube warmth: the snare's body and wires grow.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Skin Ring
presets.description: A struck membrane tuned near the drum: adds a tone to a dead snare.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Clap Spread
presets.description: The clap's transients widened by the resonance's stereo and a short room.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tight Rim
presets.description: Short and dry: sustain down on every band, attack up on the top.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Brushed Air
presets.description: Attack softened, the top's sustain and air lifted: a brush-like snare.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Metal Snare
presets.description: A plate of metal struck by the snare: an industrial clang under the hit.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Room Burst
presets.description: Transients sent into a short Afterglow and the tail lifted: a snare in a live room.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Crushed Snare
presets.description: Diode drive and clip on the body and top for a trashy, compressed crack.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Octave Snap
presets.description: The top band's transients an octave up (H2 only): a brighter, synthetic snap.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tom Bloom
presets.description: Tom sustain grows and rings at its pitch, tracked from the low band.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tom Gate
presets.description: Short toms: sustain cut so fills stay clear.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Wood Block
presets.description: Hits strike a wooden bar: marimba-like body under any percussion.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Glass Ping
presets.description: Struck glass, slowly beating partials: delicate rings from hand percussion.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Conga Snap
presets.description: The slap of hand drums brought forward, the body tightened.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tube Toms
presets.description: Toms through a tube curve on the body: fuller, rounder, a little louder in the mix.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Steel Pan Hit
presets.description: A metal plate tuned to a major chord: hits become steel-drum notes.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Shaker Shape
presets.description: Shakers and tambourines: the attack lifted on the top band only, sustain trimmed.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tabla Tone
presets.description: Tracked pitch with a fifth above: percussion that sings its own note.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Cowbell Clank
presets.description: Metal body tuned high with a short decay: any hit becomes a clank.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Hat Tick
presets.description: Hi-hat transients sharpened, the wash pulled down.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Cymbal Wash
presets.description: Ride and crash sustain lifted, attack softened: a longer, smoother wash.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tape Hats
presets.description: Tape curve on the top band: hats lose the fizz and gain density.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Sizzle
presets.description: High-order harmonics on the transients only: air and sparkle on dull hats.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Short Hats
presets.description: Closed hats made shorter still: sustain cut and lookahead on the attack.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Metal Shimmer
presets.description: Metal resonators high in the range ring under the cymbals.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Soft Hats
presets.description: Spiky programmed hats tamed: attack down, a little drive for body.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Rectified Hats
presets.description: Full-wave rectified top: hats an octave of grit higher.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Open Hat Tame
presets.description: Open hats shorter and softer: attack down, sustain down, a darker top.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Ride Ping
presets.description: The ride's ping forward and a metal ring under it.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Bus Glue
presets.description: Gentle attack lift on all bands with tube warmth: the starting point for a drum bus.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Punch Bus
presets.description: More attack, less sustain, lookahead: drums jump out.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Smash Bus
presets.description: Clipped transients and sustain up on the mid band: room-mic smash in one instance.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Parallel Crush
presets.description: Heavy drive and sustain on the wet signal, mixed under the dry.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Clipper Bus
presets.description: Transient clip on every band: peaks shaved for level without dulling the hits.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tape Bus
presets.description: Tape curve on every band, a softer top: drums from a cassette deck.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Breakbeat Snap
presets.description: For sampled breaks: top-band snap, low-band weight, a little phantom bass.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Dry Bus
presets.description: Sustain trimmed on every band: drums as if the room were smaller.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Room Bloom
presets.description: Sustain up and a short Afterglow from the transients: drums in a bigger room.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Mid/Side Snap
presets.description: Mid/side mode: the centre (kick, snare) snaps, the sides stay as they are.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Lo-Fi Bus
presets.description: Rectified and folded drive, the top darkened: a dusty sampler bus.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Room Lift
presets.description: Room mics: sustain up on the low and mid bands for more space.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Overhead Focus
presets.description: Overheads: snare and cymbal transients forward, the wash down.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Ambience Pull
presets.description: Spill and ambience reduced: sustain cut, transients kept.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Crunchy Room
presets.description: Room mics driven into a tube curve and pulled back in parallel.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Glass Room
presets.description: A long Afterglow fed only by the transients: a reverb that follows the hits.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Mono Room
presets.description: Low end made mono below 150 Hz, room sustain up.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Close Mic
presets.description: Overheads made closer: attack up, sustain down, lookahead.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Dark Ambience
presets.description: Room sustain up with a darker top: a softer, warmer space.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Snare Mic Spill
presets.description: Snare bottom and spill cleaned: sustain down on the low and mid bands, lookahead.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Bass Weight
presets.description: Low-band sustain and H2 on the low end: a fuller bass that holds its level.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Phone Bass
presets.description: Phantom harmonics with the fundamental trimmed: the bass line reads on small speakers.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Pick Attack
presets.description: Plucks and picks brought forward on the upper band.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Octave Under
presets.description: A clean octave down under the bass line, mono.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Growl
presets.description: Upper-band fold drive and H3 on the low band: an aggressive, harmonic bass.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: 808 Glide
presets.description: 808s: sustain up, H2 for audibility, a deep octave below for the tail.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: 808 Punch
presets.description: 808s with a stronger front: the click and first cycle pushed, the tail held.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Transformer Low
presets.description: Transformer recipe on the low band: H2 and H3 for iron-like weight.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Synth Bass Edge
presets.description: High band tape drive and attack: synth basses with more edge.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Upright Body
presets.description: Wood resonance tracked from the bass: an acoustic body under DI bass.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Two Octaves Down
presets.description: The deepest sub: two octaves below, clean, mono.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Pick Snap
presets.description: Pick attack forward on the mid and top bands.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Sustainer
presets.description: Sustain up on every band: notes ring longer, like a sustainer pickup.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tube Strum
presets.description: Tube curve on the mid band, a little on the top: warmer strummed acoustics.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Fuzz Face
presets.description: Asymmetric soft drive with bias on the mid band: a classic fuzz colour.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Octave Fuzz
presets.description: Full-wave rectified mid band: an octave-up fuzz.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Clean Clarity
presets.description: Body sustain trimmed, presence harmonics on the top: clearer clean guitars.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Sympathetic Strings
presets.description: Resonators on the song's scale ring with the playing, like sympathetic strings.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Palm Mute Tight
presets.description: Palm mutes tightened: sustain cut on the low and mid bands.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Shimmer Guitar
presets.description: An octave of harmonics and a long Afterglow from the full signal.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Slide Resonance
presets.description: Resonators follow the tracked pitch an octave apart: slide guitar with a glowing halo.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Vocal Presence
presets.description: H2 on the mid band, a gentle tape top: a vocal that sits forward.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: De-Breath
presets.description: Body sustain down a little: breaths and room between words recede.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Consonant Lift
presets.description: Consonants and plosive fronts brought up on the top band.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Soft Esses
presets.description: The top band's transients softened: a gentle de-esser by shape.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tube Vocal
presets.description: Tube curve on the mid and low bands: warmth and density.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Radio Voice
presets.description: Lows muted, diode drive in the middle: a small-speaker, telephone voice.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Vocal Air
presets.description: High-order harmonics and sustain on the top band: breathy air.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Choir Ring
presets.description: Resonators on the scale, struck softly by the full signal: a halo of pitches.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Rap Punch
presets.description: Front of each word pushed, a little clip: rap and spoken vocals that cut.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Distant Vocal
presets.description: Softened fronts and a long Afterglow: the vocal steps back.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Piano Hammer
presets.description: Hammer attack forward on the top band, the low end held.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Piano Bloom
presets.description: Sustain up and soft drive: a piano that blooms after each note.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Rhodes Bark
presets.description: Electric piano bark: tube drive on the mid band's transients only.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Pluck Tighten
presets.description: Synth plucks tighter: sustain cut, lookahead, attack up.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Pad Swell
presets.description: Pads: attack softened on every band, sustain lifted.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Organ Grit
presets.description: Saw recipe on the mid band, a touch of drive: an organ with more bite.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Square Lead
presets.description: Odd orders on the mid band: a hollow, square-wave colour on any lead.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Bell Keys
presets.description: Bell recipe on the top band: odd high orders over a reduced fundamental.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Harp Strings
presets.description: Notes strike tuned resonators on the scale: a harp-like halo.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: MIDI Resonator
presets.description: The resonators follow MIDI notes: play chords into the plug-in's MIDI input.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Master Warmth
presets.description: Gentle tube on every band and linear-phase bands: a little density for the mix.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Mix Punch
presets.description: A light attack lift on every band with lookahead: a mix that moves more.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Air Exciter
presets.description: H2 and H3 on the top band only: an exciter for the mix's air.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Bass Translation
presets.description: Phantom harmonics for the low end and mono below 100 Hz: the mix on small speakers.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tape Master
presets.description: Tape curve on every band, the top darkened a touch.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Loud Clip
presets.description: Transient clip on every band and the clip guard: level without a limiter's pumping.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tame Transients
presets.description: Attack softened a little on every band: a smoother, less spiky mix.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Mid/Side Body
presets.description: Mid/side: the centre's body lifted a little, the sides passed untouched.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Transformer Master
presets.description: Transformer recipe on the low band, linear phase: iron colour in the bass only.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Cosmic Ray
presets.description: Folded drive, struck metal and a long Afterglow: every hit becomes a strange event.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Glass Rain
presets.description: Hats and percussion strike high glass: a shower of tuned pings.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tube Organ Hit
presets.description: Closed-tube resonance (odd harmonics) tuned low: a pipe-organ thump.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Comb Machine
presets.description: A comb resonator, wide and long: every transient becomes a metallic flange.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Transient Only
presets.description: Listen to the transients alone: the attack layer, everything else removed.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Body Only
presets.description: Listen to the body alone: drums without their attacks, a ghostly tail.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Muon Decay
presets.description: Sustain inverted (cut) and a long Afterglow from the transients: hits become swells.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Harmonic Storm
presets.description: Every order at full on every band: a wall of harmonics from any source.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Sub Bomb
presets.description: Two octaves down and phantom on everything: a sub-harmonic drop.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Chord Machine
presets.description: Transients strike a minor chord that follows the tracked bass: instant harmony.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Wood Xylo
presets.description: Hits strike a tuned wooden bar: a xylophone voice for any rhythm.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Rectifier Swarm
presets.description: Rectified drive on every band at full mix: buzzing, octave-up chaos.
presets.author: Chromosphere
